register.labelZh: EAT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: eat in 表示在家吃飯;eat out 則表示到餐廳或咖啡店用膳。；eat away at 可以描述表面受到慢慢侵蝕;eat into 可以表示損害深入內部;eat somethingaway 則可表示某部分逐漸被侵蝕或毀掉。；eat away at somebody 表示某種情緒長時間困擾某人;eat somebody up 則表示強烈情緒佔據內心,使人十分痛苦。；eat something up 會說明要吃完哪種食物;當大家已知道所指的食物時,eat up 可作為簡短自然的指示。
register.summaryEn: Eat in means having a meal at home, while eat out means having one at a restaurant or café. Eat away at can describe slow damage to a surface, eat into can show damage going inside, and eat something away can show part of something being removed or destroyed. Eat away at somebody describes a feeling that troubles someone over time. Eat somebody up shows a strong feeling filling and hurting someone inside. Eat something up names the food that must be finished. Eat up gives a short, natural instruction when the food is already clear.
